trails.note: Circle (1035,1430). From the Taxi end (~1306,1318) it follows the green-dotted branch down-left between the Rabbit Trail label and the Doe Woods trees. It then runs along the top of the Rabbit Park pill, which covers the open strip there (the 2017-18 map, which has no parks, printed The Boulevard on that strip at y~1410). From there it passes its circle and goes down-left through the open base area to the Taxi Quad bottom terminal (~835,1468). The line under or along the pill is approximate.

Circle (1070,1460). Starts at the Perry Merrill Ave / Queen's Highway junction (~1290,1439) and runs west along the open strip below The Boulevard; a tree band separates the two strips east of x~1050, which the 2017-18 map shows without the 2025 labels on top. Passes through its label, then crosses the open base area to the Stateside base by the Bonaventure Quad bottom terminal (~772,1478). West of x~1000 it shares the open base slope with The Boulevard, 5-15 px below it.

Circle (1178,1340). The label lies on the narrow open strip along the SE side of the Taxi Quad, the strip the Rabbit Park arrow points to. Traced from the Taxi / Boulevard junction (~1300,1320) down-left along that strip to where it pinches against the Taxi Quad at the Rabbit Hole arrow (~1070,1366). The map does not show where it goes after that. OSM has Rabbit Trail crossing under the Taxi Quad to Lower Can Am; it could also continue along the lift line to the base. Only the visible part is traced.

Square (1314,1007) is at the top of a straight open lane that continues the 601 cut below Taxi. The 2017-18 Jay map printed 'Power Line' where 601 is now and 'Lower Power Line' where Micky is, so this is the power-line cut. Traced from its X with Taxi (~1368,974) down-left along the lane, about 45-60 px NW of the Bonaventure Quad. On the SE side are the Show-off Glade trees and the Lower Lift Line strip; on the NW side a tree line with Bonaventure Glade beyond. The points average the straight 601 extension and the open lane, which are up to 20 px apart at the ends. Ends where the lane enters the Kangaroo Trail slow zone (dots start at y~1210), at ~(1080,1215). Not continued inside the dotted zone.

Square (1339,1061) sits in the open cut along the NW side of the Bonaventure Quad; the SE side is dense conifers. The 'Lift Line' diamond (1488,959) labels the same cut above the Taxi crossing. Traced ~12 px NW of the lift from the Taxi crossing (~1400,1024) down to where the Kangaroo Trail slow zone pinches out against the lift (~1130,1214; the reviewed Kangaroo trace starts at 1128,1220).

Circle (1368,1156) is in the dotted zone below the lift where the Upper Can Am cut (the open strip between the lift's conifer band and the Buckaroo Bonzai band) and Taxi meet. Traced from that confluence (~1432,1094) through the label, then down the green-dotted lane along the SE side of the Bonaventure Quad. Continues down the middle of the corridor between the Bonaventure Quad and the Taxi Quad to the base by the two bottom terminals (~795,1440). The corridor part is less certain: on the 2025-26 map it is terrain-park dotted (The Rusch, The Gully, Rabbit Hole), but the 2017-18 map printed 'Lower Can Am' in that corridor and OSM's Lower Can Am runs down it.

Circle (1363,1417). Follows the narrow green-dotted band that leaves the top of the central slow zone at the Metro Quad top station (~1950,1302) and passes under the Aerial Tram. It runs west between a conifer band and a conifer island (Full Moon leaves it at ~1722,1343), past the tops of Half Moon and Quarter Moon, through its label to the Chalet Meadows / Queen's Highway junction (~1290,1439), where the reviewed Queen's Highway starts.

Printed twice (squares (1333,924) and (1440,1183)); traced as one run through both. Starts at the Angel's Wiggle hairpin / Upper Milk Run junction (~1304,838; shares its first ~50 px with the reviewed Lower Milk Run), runs down the open strip left of the big conifer band past the upper square, then down-right through the open snow NW of the Bonaventure Quad, crossing the power-line cut (X with 601/Micky at ~1368,974). Crosses the lift at ~(1404,1029) through the only gap in the conifer band on the lift's SE side, meets the bottom of the Upper Can Am cut at ~(1430,1093), goes straight down the dotted slow zone past the lower square, then follows the dotted corridor down-left (Lower Goat Run joins from the right at ~1440,1240) to the junction at the top of the Taxi Quad slope (~1306,1318) where The Boulevard and Rabbit Trail begin. OSM's Taxi has the same topology (hairpin, Micky/601 junction, Lift Line crossing, Upper/Middle Can Am junction, Boulevard start). The lower end is the least certain part.
